head: 131b33ef3118882e7aa414f9b245be10a5ef37c7
scope: evidence-first audit after v0.1.1 convergence; preserve active owner edits; no tag/push/release mutation; only isolated evidence written

version_state.interpretation: v0.1.1 was release-preparation state and was superseded before tag publication; current canonical release metadata is v0.1.3

ci_contract.metadata_gate: pushed tag must equal v${versionName}; CHANGELOG must contain matching release section
publisher_requires: version-matched tag at exact tested SHA
successful same-SHA Android E2E Conformance push

hosted_state.assessment: The release publisher is fail-closed as designed. Package/build/signature/artifact upload succeeded, while screenshot and same-SHA E2E qualification did not.

publication.note: A direct re-download/hash refresh of the 49.5 MB published APK was attempted during this audit but interrupted due slow transfer; same-day prior audit r21 records published SHA-256 2a0c49c5fd5f063fa960ea8af83b21de144a05cab645eec69ebf4df70948e9c4.

local_artifact.assessment: valid non-debuggable sideload/development release build; not production-store signed and not canonical for publication because the worktree is dirty

offline_download_store.residual_risk: future persisted-field changes need an explicit version/migration boundary

release_variant_security.assessment: appropriate for sideload review; Play/store production signing and stricter backup policy remain separate hardening work

tgtext.assessment: Both current local and published v0.1.3 APK sizes fit the existing 50 MiB tgtext document ceiling; use the published v0.1.3 asset for canonical delivery while the worktree is dirty.

warnings: AGP 8.5.2 reports compileSdk 35 is newer than its certified compileSdk 34 range.
Automatic release publication would remain blocked until hosted Android CI and same-SHA E2E gates are green.
OfflineDownloadStore has no explicit persisted schema version/migration contract.
